pdf.js 3.11.174, for fsu-tests/pdf2png.js only (the app never loads it). Byte-identical to
build/pdf.min.js and build/pdf.worker.min.js in the npm package pdfjs-dist@3.11.174, and to
cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/. Licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE beside this file).
Kept here so rendering a PDF needs no network and no trust in whatever certificate the network
presents. Check with: cd fsu-tests/vendor/pdfjs && grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{64}  ' SOURCES.txt | sha256sum -c
